info.title: Scrapix API

post.summary: Scrape many URLs as one job
post.description:
Starts a job that runs the `/scrape` pipeline for every URL (bounded
concurrency) and returns its `job_id` immediately. Track it with
`GET /job/{id}/status`, `/job/{id}/events` or webhooks, read the pages
with `GET /job/{id}/results`, cancel with `DELETE /job/{id}`. A URL that
fails is reported as a result with `success: false` and an `error`; it
does not fail the batch. Credits: same as `/scrape`, per URL scraped.

402.description: Not enough credits for the whole batch

post.summary: Create a new async crawl job
Create multiple crawl jobs from a batch of configs
Create a sync crawl job (waits for completion)
post.description:
With `include_results=true`, the response also carries the first page of
the job's results (`GET /job/{id}/results`).

parameters.name: include_results
parameters.description: Also return the first page of the job's results (default false)

parameters.name: results_limit
parameters.description: Page size of the included results (default 20, max 100)

post.summary: Extract structured data from web pages
post.description:
Starts a job that fetches every URL (globs such as
`https://example.com/blog/*` are resolved first, 50 URLs max), then runs
one AI extraction over their content following `prompt` and/or `schema`.
Poll `GET /extract/{id}` for the result; the fetched pages are available
from `GET /job/{id}/results`. Requires an AI provider on the server.

503.description: No AI provider is configured on the server

get.summary: Get an extraction's status and result
Service health endpoint — reports liveness of each component

delete.description:
Stops the job everywhere (frontier and workers) and bills the pages
crawled so far. Only a pending, running or paused job can be cancelled:
a job that already completed, failed or was cancelled returns 409 and
keeps its status.

post.description:
The frontier stops dispatching the job's URLs (pages already in flight
finish). Only a running job can be paused; any other status returns 409.

get.summary: Get the results of a job
get.description:
Paginated documents produced by a crawl, batch scrape or extract job,
each shaped like a `/scrape` response. Works while the job is running
(partial results) and after it finished. Follow `next` until it is
`null`; while the job runs, `next` stays set so it can be polled.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next`

503.description: The job's result store is unreachable

post.description: Only a paused job can be resumed; any other status returns 409.

post.summary: Map a website: sitemap-first discovery with optional BFS deep crawl
post.description:
Discovers URLs via:
1. Sitemap parsing (robots.txt → sitemap.xml → sitemap indexes)
2. Optional BFS link crawling when `depth > 0`

Each URL can be enriched with title, description (from HTML head) and
lastmod, priority, changefreq (from sitemap data) depending on `get_*` flags.

Converts an uploaded file to Markdown with the same parsers the crawler
uses, and returns the `/scrape` response shape. Billed per document
(like `/scrape`), plus OCR pages when `parsers.ocr` recognizes scanned
pages.

post.summary:
Scrape a single URL and return content immediately
This bypasses the job queue for instant results

422.description: A browser action failed (`action_error`; `details` names the action)

post.summary: Proxy search to the account's default Meilisearch engine.

oneOf.description:
Wait a fixed time (`ms`) or until an element matching `selector`
exists. Exactly one of the two must be set.
Click the first element matching `selector` (waits for it to exist).
Scroll the page by `amount` viewport heights (default 1).
Focus the first element matching `selector` and type `text` into it.

Press a key (e.g. `Enter`, `Tab`, `ArrowDown`, `Escape`, `a`) on the
focused element.

Run JavaScript in the page. The value of the script (or of its
`return` statement; `await` is allowed) is returned in
`actions.javascript_returns`, JSON-serialized.

Action.description:
A browser interaction run on the page after it loads and before content
(and any screenshot) is captured. Actions run in order; the first one to
fail stops the sequence and fails the request.

schema.description: Schema with field definitions (alternative to prompt)

AiFieldDef.description: Field definition for AI schema-based extraction

BatchScrapeRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /batch/scrape`. Every field besides `urls`,
`concurrency` and `webhooks` is a `POST /scrape` option applied to each
URL (the most common ones are listed; any `/scrape` option is accepted).

actions.description: Browser actions run on each page before capture (forces browser rendering)

cookies.description:
Cookies sent with each request. A cookie without `domain` goes to each
URL's own host; one with `domain` must be that URL's host or a parent
of it, otherwise that URL fails with a per-item error.

exclude_selectors.description: CSS selectors to remove before extraction

extract.description: Custom CSS selector extraction (field_name -> selector definition)

formats.description: Formats to return for each URL (default: markdown, content, metadata)

include_links.description: Include links found on each page

include_selectors.description: CSS selectors to keep (only extract from these)

render_js.description: Render JavaScript (requires Chrome/Chromium on the server)

BulkCrawlError.description: Error for a single config in a bulk submission

errors.description: Number of jobs that failed to create

browser_pool_size.description: Browser pool size for JS rendering

ContentBlock.description: A single content block extracted from the document

heading.description: Heading text that starts this block

CrawlConfig.description: Main configuration for a crawl job

allowed_domains.description:
Allowed domains for crawling (if empty, inferred from start_urls)
When set, only URLs from these exact domains will be crawled.
This prevents domain explosion (e.g., crawling all Wikipedia languages
when you only want en.wikipedia.org)

index_strategy.description:
Indexing strategy: how documents are written to the target index.
- `update`: add/update documents in the existing index (default)
- `replace`: index into a temporary index, then atomically swap on completion

Also accepts the legacy field name `replace_index` (bool) for backward compatibility.

index_uid.description: Meilisearch index UID (auto-generated from start_urls[0] if empty)

max_depth.description: Maximum crawl depth from start URLs

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl

meilisearch.description: Meilisearch settings (optional — resolved from account's default engine when empty)

source.description:
Source identifier for multi-tenant indexing.
When set, all documents from this crawl job are tagged with this value,
enabling per-source filtering and deletion within a shared index.
Falls back to the domain if not set.

oneOf.description:
First page of results (`include_results=true`). Follow `results.next`
with `GET /job/{id}/results`. Meilisearch indexes asynchronously, so
the very last pages of a just-finished crawl can take a moment to
appear.

results_error.description: Why the results could not be read (`include_results=true`)

CrawlSyncResponse.description:
`POST /crawl/sync` response: the final job status, plus the first page
of results when `include_results=true`

warnings.description:
Non-fatal warnings about config fields that were accepted but cannot
be honored per-job (worker-level settings). Empty when there are none.

selectors.description: Map of field name to CSS selector(s)

content_type.description: Canonical media type of the format.

has_tables.description: Tables were detected and rendered as Markdown tables.

needs_ocr.description: Whether some pages still have no text (not OCR'd).

DocumentsConfig.description:
Opt-in configuration for office/other document scraping (DOCX, XLSX,
PPTX, legacy DOC/XLS/PPT, ODT/ODS/ODP, RTF, EPUB, CSV).

enabled.description: Whether office/other document scraping is enabled.

max_size_mb.description:
Maximum document size in megabytes. Larger documents are rejected
before being buffered. When `None`, the global fetcher
`max_body_size` applies.

headers.description: Custom request headers for the page fetches

only_main_content.description: Only use each page's main content (default true)

prompt.description: What to extract, in natural language

render_js.description: Render JavaScript when fetching pages (requires Chrome/Chromium)

schema.description:
Expected output: a JSON Schema object, or a list of field
definitions `[{ "name", "description", "field_type", "required" }]`
(the `/scrape` `ai.extract.schema` form)

urls.description:
URLs to extract from (max 50 in total after glob resolution). A URL
containing `*` is a glob resolved from the site's sitemaps and the
links of its base page: `https://example.com/blog/*`.

error.description: Why the page could not be fetched

from_glob.description: The glob this URL was resolved from, if any

success.description: Whether the page was fetched (`null` until it was tried)

data.description: The extracted data (`null` until the job completed)

sources.description: URLs used, including those resolved from globs

warning.description: Non-fatal issues: truncated context, failed pages, capped globs, ...

ExtractedSchema.description: Extracted schema data from an HTML document

json_ld.description: All JSON-LD data found (may be array or object)

oneOf.description: Extract outer HTML (including the element itself)
Extract as a list of values (for multiple matches)
Extract as list of objects with multiple fields
Extract first match only (returns null if not found)

ExtractionMode.description: How to extract the value from matched elements

FeatureToggle.description: Simple feature toggle with page filters

include_pages.description: Only apply to pages matching these patterns

oneOf.description:
Office/other document scraping (opt-in): Word, PowerPoint, Excel,
OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB and CSV responses are converted to Markdown
and indexed alongside HTML pages. Disabled by default.

OCR for scanned / image-only PDF pages (opt-in, `off` by default:
OCR is slow and billed at a higher per-page rate).

PDF scraping (opt-in). When enabled, the crawler fetches
`application/pdf` responses, extracts layout-aware Markdown +
metadata, and indexes them alongside HTML pages. Disabled by default.

attribute.description: Attribute name if mode is Attribute

selector.description: CSS selector relative to parent element

IndexStrategy.description: Indexing strategy for a crawl job.

JobResultError.description: Error of a failed result item

JobResultItem.description:
A single job result, shaped like a `/scrape` response. Fields a job did
not produce (formats/features it did not request) are omitted.

block_url.description: URL of the block (with its anchor), when the crawl split pages into blocks

crawled_at.description: When the page was crawled (crawl jobs)

index.description: Position of `source_url` in the submitted `urls` (batch scrape / extract)

page_block.description: Block index within the page, when the crawl split pages into blocks

success.description: Whether this page was scraped successfully

JobResultsResponse.description: One page of a job's results

data.description: Results, each shaped like a `/scrape` response

next.description:
Cursor of the next page; `null` once the job is terminal and every
result was returned. Always set while the job runs.

status.description: Job status at the time of the read

total.description: Number of results available so far

warnings.description:
Job-level warnings raised by workers while running the job (e.g. a
requested feature a worker cannot honor), deduplicated. Omitted when
there are none.

MapLink.description: A discovered link with optional metadata

depth.description: How many levels deep to follow links beyond sitemap (default: 0, max: 5)

get_changefreq.description: Include changefreq from sitemap data (default: true)

get_description.description: Fetch <meta description> from each page's HTML head (default: true)

get_lastmod.description: Include lastmod from sitemap data (default: true)

get_priority.description: Include priority from sitemap data (default: true)

get_title.description: Fetch <title> from each page's HTML head (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return (default: 5000)

render_js.description: Render JavaScript before extracting metadata (requires Chrome/Chromium)

search.description: Filter results to URLs matching this search term

sitemap.description: Whether to use sitemaps for discovery (default: true)

max_pages.description:
Per-document OCR page cap. Can only lower the server-wide cap
(`OCR_MAX_PAGES_PER_DOCUMENT`, default 50), never raise it.

OcrInfo.description: What OCR did (present when `parsers.ocr` is not `off`).

pages_cached.description: Of `pages_processed`, pages served from the OCR cache (not billed).

pages_capped.description: Pages that needed OCR but exceeded the page cap or daily budget.

pages_processed.description: Pages whose text now comes from OCR.

pages_skipped.description: Pages left on the native text-extraction path.

OcrMode.description: When to run OCR on a document.

ParseRequestOptions.description: Options part of a `/parse` upload (the `options` multipart field, JSON).

formats.description:
Formats to return (default: markdown, content, metadata). `html`,
`rawhtml`, `schema`, `blocks` and `screenshot` do not apply to
documents.

include_links.description: Include links found in the document.

file.description:
The document: PDF, DOC/DOCX, PPT/PPTX, XLS/XLSX/XLSB, ODT/ODS/ODP,
RTF, EPUB or CSV (or a PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/TIFF image with
`parsers.ocr`). Max 50 MB by default (`DOCUMENT_MAX_SIZE_MB`).

formats.description: Shorthand for `options.formats`: a JSON array or comma-separated list.

max_pages.description: Parse at most this many PDF pages (the first N).

ocr.description:
OCR for scanned / image-only pages: `off` (default — scanned pages
are flagged in `document.pages_needing_ocr`, not recognized), `auto`
(OCR only the pages that need it) or `force` (OCR every page, for
PDFs whose broken font encodings extract as garbage). OCR pages are
billed at a higher per-page rate.

ocr_max_pages.description:
Per-document OCR page cap. Can only lower the server cap
(`OCR_MAX_PAGES_PER_DOCUMENT`, default 50).

PdfConfig.description:
Opt-in configuration for PDF scraping.

When `enabled = true`, PDFs are fetched (with base64-encoded transport
through the content worker), parsed into layout-aware Markdown (tables,
multi-column reading order) + metadata, and indexed into the same
Meilisearch index. All other fields default to conservative values.

extract_links.description:
Follow hyperlinks found inside PDFs (link annotations): the crawler
publishes them to the frontier like links found in HTML, subject to
the job's usual domain/pattern/depth rules.

max_pages.description:
Parse at most this many pages of each PDF (the first N). `None`
parses every page.

max_size_mb.description:
Maximum PDF size in megabytes. PDFs larger than this are rejected.
When `None`, the global fetcher `max_body_size` applies.

default_crawl_delay_ms.description:
Per-domain delay (ms) used when the domain's robots.txt was fetched
and sets no `Crawl-delay`, and the job sets neither
`per_domain_delay_ms` (> 0) nor `requests_per_second` /
`requests_per_minute`. 0 (default) = no extra delay.

per_domain_delay_ms.description: Minimum delay between requests to same domain (ms)

RequestCookie.description: A cookie to send with a one-off fetch (HTTP or browser).

domain.description:
Cookie domain. Defaults to the target URL's host (host-only cookie).
Must be the target host or a parent domain of it.

javascript_returns.description:
Values of the `execute_javascript` actions, in order (JSON
round-tripped; `undefined` is `null`)

actions.description:
Browser actions run after the page loads and before content (and
any screenshot) is captured: wait, click, scroll, write, press,
execute_javascript. Forces browser rendering. At most 50; all
actions together must finish within 30s.

cookies.description:
Cookies sent with the request (both the HTTP and the browser path),
scoped to the target site: a cookie's `domain` must be the target
host or a parent domain of it. At most 50.

exclude_selectors.description: CSS selectors to remove before extraction

extract.description: Custom CSS selector extraction (field_name -> selector definition)

headers.description: Custom headers to send with the request

include_links.description: Include links found on the page

include_selectors.description: CSS selectors to keep (only extract from these)

mobile.description:
Emulate a phone (mobile viewport, touch, Android Chrome user agent)
to get the mobile layout of responsive sites. Forces browser
rendering.

only_main_content.description: Whether to only return the main content (excludes nav, footer, etc.)

parsers.description:
Document parsing options, used when the URL serves a PDF or an
office document (OCR of scanned pages, page limits).

render_js.description: Render JavaScript before extracting content (requires Chrome/Chromium)

oneOf.description: Results of the request's `actions` (present when actions were sent)

blocks.description: Content blocks split by headings (if format "blocks" requested)

oneOf.description:
Document details, when the URL served (or the upload is) a PDF or an
office document: format, pages, and which pages still need OCR.

links.description: Links found on the page (if requested)

oneOf.description: What OCR did, when `parsers.ocr` requested it.
JSON-LD and structured data (if format "schema" requested)

scrape_duration_ms.description: Time taken to scrape in milliseconds

url.description: The URL that was scraped (after redirects)

full_page.description:
Capture the whole scrollable page (default) instead of only the
viewport. Very long pages are cropped to 16384 px.

default.description: Default value if no match found

transform.description: Transform the extracted value (trim, lowercase, etc.)

SelectorDefinition.description: Definition for a single selector extraction

ServiceStatus.description: Service health status for each component

enabled.description: Whether to discover and use sitemaps (default: true)

oneOf.description: Parse as number (returns null if fails)

allowed_domains.description:
Allowed domains for crawling (strict whitelist)
When non-empty, only URLs from these exact domains are allowed.
No subdomain inference or parent domain escapes.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for URLs to exclude

include.description: Glob patterns for URLs to include

index_only.description: Only index URLs matching these patterns (but crawl all)

events.description: Events to send to this webhook
